notes.note: Speakers verified against 0726.bla (MessWinSet +N shows entry N+1). #0.53-67 is the leader block after Zetton's second attack, chain 11-15,1-10: #0.56 Mebius, #0.57 Zero, #0.58 Rider 1, #0.59 RX, #0.60 Momotaros, #0.61 W, #0.62 OOO, #0.63 Nu, #0.64 Zeta, #0.65 God, #0.66 Wing Zero, #0.67 00. Wording fits (Rider 1's more formal wording, God's long scream, curt Nu/Heero/Setsuna). The plain wording kept as 'What power!!'; the formal variant as 'What incredible power!!' to match #0.53-55 in story_157.
Fragment 'this power...!?' given a verb: 'What is this power!?'.

#0.69-98: one call with a step-2 variant (+68+2k / +69+2k), same leader chain: pairs for Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Mebius, Zero, Rider 1, RX, Momotaros, W, OOO, Nu, Zeta, God, Wing Zero, 00. The three Ultras say 'as expected' (they know Zetton) -> 'after all'; the rest say 'considerably' -> 'seriously'. Identical Japanese kept identical.
Subject restored as 'we' (leader speaking for the party under attack); same for every 'can't afford to lose' line in this block.
Mebius. Source trails off ('can't lose here...!!'); kept the trailing ellipsis rather than completing the clause.
Momotaros. Source stretches the negative over a pause ('can't lose... no way!'); rendered with the pause and 'No way in hell' for the drawn-out rough ending.
Nu / Wing Zero / 00 (identical source): 'at this level' rendered 'not to something like this'.
Zetton's death roar (explosion and fade follow). Same Japanese roar as Giant Greeed's 'Gwoooooooooooooh!!!' in story_058; reused with two '!'.
Ankh: the stone pillar's light again, as in 0724 #0.55.

Leader block #0.103-117 uses the post-battle chain 4,5,2,3,1,14,15,12,13,11,9,10,7,8,6: W, OOO, RX, Momotaros, Rider 1, Mebius, Zero, Seven, Taro, Ultraman, Zeta, God, Nu, Wing Zero, 00. Wording confirms (#0.104 OOO's soft particle, #0.108 Mebius's polite form). Elliptic 'the clouds' color too' completed as 'have changed color too' (echoes 0724 #0.56-70). The script then calls entry #0.118 for Ankh, which does not exist in the table (same pattern at the end of 0727 and 0728); probably a script quirk, nothing to translate.
0727 #0.1-2: narration (no name box) when inspecting the pillar; same text as 0725 #0.1-2, translated identically.
Ankh. 'This thing' = the stone pillar (it keeps emitting Minus Energy; dealing with it gets nowhere).
Ankh, hit by the pillar's energy; matches earlier 'Gwah...'.

Leader block #0.2-16, chain 13,12,11,15,14,2,1,5,4,3,7,6,10,9,8: Taro, Seven, Ultraman, Zero, Mebius, RX, Rider 1, OOO, W, Momotaros, Zeta, Nu, 00, Wing Zero, God. Only the interjection differs. The script's final Ankh call (+16) points past the table end.

Speaker is Tyrant (script: name 176 at +1). 0729 has a non-null empty entry 0.0, so its script numbering maps +N to entry N, not N+1. The extracted labels in story_159 are therefore shifted by one (e.g. #0.2 'Tyrant' is really the first party variant); #0.1 here is Tyrant's silent '...'.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified against 0726/0727/0728/0729 bytecode; all leader blocks voiced per their Pt_Chara_Check chains. 0729 uses N->N numbering (non-null empty entry 0.0), so #0.1 '...' is Tyrant and story_159's extracted labels are shifted by one row. Final Ankh MessWinSet in 0726/0727/0728 points one past the table end (no text). No new names; Zetton roar reused from Giant Greeed's identical roar.
